title: Growing low-dispersion gaze windows
description: You can follow candidate windows into fixation records.

steps.description: The function derives a minimum sample count and starts a candidate window at i. You measure dispersion as the sum of the horizontal and vertical ranges.
A sufficiently compact candidate grows one sample at a time. You break when adding a sample exceeds the dispersion threshold.

steps.question: Does the centroid include the sample that caused the threshold break?
steps.answer: No. The centroid uses points[i:j], excluding that newly tested sample at index j.

steps.description: You append the accepted window's indices, centroid and length-derived measure, then continue at j. A rejected initial window instead advances i by one.
The caller prints one record per detected fixation. The supplied output excerpt lists eight records with their centroids.
